ValidationRule.description: VAT Number or Company Registration Number or Other Fiscal ID are obligatory on the account
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), NOT(IsPersonAccount), ISBLANK(ER_VAT_Number__c), ISBLANK( ER_Registration_Number__c), ISBLANK( ER_Other_Fiscal_ID__c), RecordType.Name = 'Company' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Filling VAT Number or Company Registration Number or Other Fiscal ID is mandatory.
